newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR JAN 27-DEC 31, 1997 (PAGE 1/11 - JAN 27-FEB 1).
newsitem.headline: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR JAN 27-DEC 31, 1997 (PAGE 1/11 - JAN 27-FEB 1).

text.p: Reuter EC Report Long-Term Diary - Part 2 of 2.
LUXEMBOURG - ECOFIN Council.
Provisional agenda includes:
- Follow-up to the European Council in Amsterdam - preparation of stage 3 of EMU.
- Adoption of the 1997 broad economic policy guidelines.
- (possibly) Financial services.
- (possibly) Taxation.
- Preparation of the Luxembourg EU presidency.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25
BRUSSELS - European Parliament holds mini session (To June 26).

AMSTERDAM - The Netherlands Industrial and Agricultural Biotechnology (NIAB) Foundation holds "EuropaBio '97" (To June 27). Speakers include: European Commissioner Brittan; Dutch Economic Affairs Minister Hans Wijers. Venue: RAI Congress Centre. Contact: Lidy Groot Congress Events (31) 20 679 3218.
THURSDAY, JUNE 26
LUXEMBOURG - General Affairs Council.
Provisional agenda include:
- Follow-up to the Amsterdam European Council.
- Former Yugoslavia.
- Middle East peace process.
- Relations with Andorra: decision to sign the cooperation agreement.
- Mediterranean policy: report on follow-up to Barcelona Conference.
- Relations with Albania: decision to sign the cooperation agreement.
- Relations with Yemen: decision to sign the cooperation agreement.
- Relations with Turkmenistan: decision to sign the partnership and cooperation Agreement.
- Relations with Switzerland: conclusion of negotiations.
- EEA Council session: preparation of the Union's position.
- In the margins of the Council:
- EEA Council;
- Signature of the cooperation agreement with Albania;
- Signature of the partnership and cooperation agreement with Turkmenistan;
- Signature of the cooperation agreement with Yemen;
- Signature of the cooperation agreement with Andorra;
- Conference of the Representatives of the Governments of the Member States: appointment of judges and advocates-general to the Court of Justice (period in office begins 7 October 1997).
LUXEMBOURG - Education Council.
Provisional agenda includes:
- White paper on education and training.
- Proposal for a decision concerning the SOCRATES budget.
- Green paper on obstacles to mobility in higher education.
- Commission communication: "Learning in the Information Society".
- Council recommendation on quality in higher education.
- Commission communication on safety at school.
- (possibly) Voluntary service for young people.
MONDAY, JUNE 30
LUXEMBOURG - Culture Council.
Provisional agenda includes:
- Directive "Television without frontiers".
- Cooperation between public broadcast corporations.
- Proposal for a decision on an European Guarantee Fund (audiovisual).
- Proposal for a decision on European Cultural Cities.
- The cultural dimension of the European unification.
- A different set-up of EU cultural programmes.
- (Possibly) Book pricing.
* Dutch EU presidency ends. Luxembourg takes over to December 31, 1997.
